shared_elements: upright stone slab/monolith carved in relief
horizontal band(s) crossing the lower field
incised linear/geometric ornament on garment or surface
justification: Both are tall, roughly rectangular carved stone monuments whose upper zone is dominated by a headdressed anthropomorphic presence and whose lower zone is crossed by horizontal bands, and both include disc-like roundels among the ornament. The rendering, however, is quite different: A is a boldly modelled, deeply cut profile figure with a naturalistic face, while B is a shallow, frontally symmetrical, largely abstract arrangement of geometric motifs on a weathered boulder-like block, so beyond the generic monolith-with-figure scheme the correspondences are weak.
